about: Facts that are established in the literature and in public curation, checked against the built index (vindex/known_loci.py). The facts are written from the field's knowledge, not read back from the index; a FAIL is adjudicated against the raw source file before anything is changed, and a retired expectation is recorded in AUDIT_LOG.md with the reason. Coordinates are GRCh38.

loci.title: HBB rs334 (c.20A>T, p.Glu7Val), the sickle-cell allele
loci.basis: Pathogenic for sickle cell disease in ClinVar and in the ACMG/ClinGen hemoglobinopathy curation; the best-known pathogenic missense allele.

loci.title: CFTR rs75527207 (c.1652G>A, p.Gly551Asp)
loci.basis: A classic cystic fibrosis gating mutation (the ivacaftor target allele); pathogenic in ClinVar.

loci.title: SERPINA1 rs28929474 (the Z allele, p.Glu366Lys; legacy Glu342Lys)
loci.basis: The common alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency allele; pathogenic in ClinVar.

loci.title: F5 rs6025 (factor V Leiden, p.Arg534Gln; legacy Arg506Gln)
loci.basis: The common inherited thrombophilia allele at chr1:169,549,811 C>T (GRCh38). Its aggregate ClinVar classification is drug response (expert panel), not pathogenic, so only the position is a fact checked here; a first version of this spec expected 'pathogenic' and was corrected against the ClinVar VCF.

loci.title: TCF7L2 rs7903146: the T allele raises type 2 diabetes risk
loci.basis: The strongest common-variant association with type 2 diabetes (odds ratio about 1.4 per T allele), replicated in every ancestry studied.

loci.title: APOE rs429358: the C allele (the epsilon-4 allele) raises Alzheimer's disease risk
loci.basis: The largest common genetic risk factor for late-onset Alzheimer's disease (about 3-fold per allele); the epsilon-4 allele is rs429358 C together with rs7412 C.

loci.title: MC4R rs17782313: the C allele raises body mass index
loci.basis: A first-wave obesity locus near MC4R (about +0.05 SD of BMI per C allele); T/C is not a strand-ambiguous SNP, so the Catalog rows can be placed on the forward strand.

loci.title: 9p21 rs10757274: the G allele raises coronary artery disease risk
loci.basis: The 9p21 locus is the most replicated common-variant locus for coronary artery disease (odds ratio about 1.2-1.4 per G allele of rs10757274).

loci.title: 4q25 rs2200733: the T allele raises atrial fibrillation risk
loci.basis: The strongest common-variant association with atrial fibrillation (odds ratio about 1.7 per T allele) near PITX2.

loci.title: 8q24 rs6983267: the G allele raises prostate and colorectal cancer risk
loci.basis: A replicated 8q24 risk locus for prostate and colorectal cancer (odds ratio about 1.2 per G allele); G/T is not strand-ambiguous.

loci.title: HLA-DRB1 rs3135388: the A allele (the reference base) raises multiple sclerosis risk
loci.basis: The tag of HLA-DRB1*15:01, the strongest multiple sclerosis risk factor (odds ratio about 2-3 per A allele). The A allele is the GRCh38 reference base, so the effect allele is REF and the other allele is ALT: this tests the orientation when the effect allele is the reference.

loci.title: FTO rs1421085: the C allele raises body mass index and obesity risk
loci.basis: A lead variant of the FTO obesity locus (odds ratio about 1.4 per C allele for obesity); T/C is not strand-ambiguous. rs9939609, the better-known FTO variant, is A/T and strand-ambiguous: the index keeps its Catalog rows as rejected unless an allele frequency resolves the strand.

loci.title: CYP2C19 *2 (rs4244285, c.681G>A)
loci.basis: The most common CYP2C19 no-function allele; defined by NC_000010.11:g.94781859G>A in the CPIC and PharmVar allele definitions.

loci.title: DPYD c.1905+1G>A (*2A, rs3918290)
loci.basis: The best-known DPYD no-function allele (fluoropyrimidine toxicity); in the CPIC allele definitions as c.1905+1G>A.

loci.title: SLCO1B1 *5 (rs4149056, c.521T>C)
loci.basis: The decreased-function SLCO1B1 allele behind simvastatin myopathy risk; defined by NC_000012.12:g.21178615T>C in the CPIC and PharmVar definitions.

loci.title: VKORC1 rs9923231 (-1639G>A) and warfarin dose
loci.basis: The promoter variant that explains the largest share of warfarin dose variance; a CPIC guideline variant and a ClinPGx clinical annotation.

loci.title: BRCA1 and hereditary breast and ovarian cancer
loci.basis: ClinGen's gene-disease validity classification for BRCA1 and hereditary cancer predisposition (hereditary breast-ovarian cancer) is Definitive; the current ClinGen export labels the disease 'BRCA1-related cancer predisposition'. This is gene-level evidence; it is not attached to any variant.

loci.title: MYBPC3 and hypertrophic cardiomyopathy
loci.basis: ClinGen's gene-disease validity classification for MYBPC3 and hypertrophic cardiomyopathy is Definitive.

loci.title: ARID1B is strongly constrained against loss of function
loci.basis: ARID1B haploinsufficiency causes Coffin-Siris syndrome; the gene is among the most loss-of-function-intolerant genes in gnomAD (LOEUF well below 0.35).

loci.title: HTT CAG repeat (Huntington disease)
loci.basis: The HTT exon 1 CAG repeat lies at chr4:3,074,876-3,074,933 (GRCh38); STRchive curates it as a pathogenic repeat locus for Huntington disease.

loci.title: FMR1 CGG repeat (fragile X syndrome)
loci.basis: The FMR1 5' UTR CGG repeat lies at chrX:147,912,050-147,912,110 (GRCh38); STRchive curates it as a pathogenic repeat locus for fragile X syndrome.

loci.title: 22q11.2 recurrent deletion (DiGeorge / velocardiofacial) region
loci.basis: ClinGen dosage sensitivity curation: haploinsufficiency of the recurrent 22q11.2 region (which includes TBX1) has sufficient evidence for dosage pathogenicity (score 3).

loci.title: MaveDB multiplexed assays of BRCA1, PTEN and TP53
loci.basis: MaveDB holds published saturation-style assays for BRCA1, PTEN and TP53 (among the first deposited in the database).
